verdict.rationale: Teller's homepage describes one connection flow after which you can verify account ownership, ACH details, balances and transactions. An enrollment is defined as one bank login covering multiple accounts, and separate balances, transactions and identity APIs exist against that access. However, no doc explicitly states that a single Teller Connect enrollment authorizes all products at once, or explains how products are scoped per session. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one enrollment grants all data products without re-linking, details on product selection or scoping in Teller Connect, and hands-on corroboration.
